laws.rule: Montevideo's departmental rules (article D.2359, from Decreto JDM 14.138 of 1967, listed as in force) prohibit selling or drinking alcoholic drinks on all of the department's beaches in any form. Breaches are punished under the Departmental Punitive Regime (Decreto 21.626), public-domain section. The fine amount for alcohol was not found. The same beach rules list noisy demonstrations that disturb the public and vehicle access to the beaches as restricted.
